value.title: Coder u4 — anomalies view, report verify, decisions

sections.name: mission
sections.value: Build exactly u4: Derive anomaly rows (status-stale, unverified-done, open-question, unacked-dispatch, dead-seat) from rs data; `report verify`; decision rows from `report question`, `pij-rs decisions`, `pij-rs answer` delivering to the asker via /v1/send. No product scope decisions; ask PM.

value.text: FIRST set cwd /Users/jordanknight/pi-hacking/fs3-rs-governance-port-u4; ABSOLUTE paths for all file tools because spawn root is main. Load BOTH pij and builder skills. Read this packet, your impl-guide row, and canonical governance routes/events JSON before proposing changes.

Canary + ACK before code: run pij whoami and quote exact output, quote actual OMP footer model/effort, then numbered implementation plan and evidence-backed seam questions via pij_send to pij-lonely-ikrie. Model is github-copilot/gpt-6-astra-1m high on OMP. Wait for PM to rule ack.

Author named baseline-compatible HTTP/CLI regressions and unit tests FIRST. Consume canonical contract fixtures rather than restating schemas. No compile-error-only RED; regression must run against old route behavior. PM owns RED/GREEN execution receipts.

CONCURRENT EDIT WAVE: skip every build/test/formatter/linter/harness boot/check and do not commit. Implement source/tests, then report READY_TO_VALIDATE with exact commands and a snap-in recipe and HOLD. PM validates after every editing seat pauses, composes, and commits. READY is not DONE.

Stay in your owned fence. Migration owner for this unit: 0015; use existing SqliteOrchestration/shared pool, never duplicate SQL in daemon/core. PM owns all common lib.rs/module/Route/Services/CLI wiring and dependency metadata.

Follow governance-routes.json#isolation for any later runtime proof: private port/state-dir/HOME/Claude+XDG homes/TMUX socket for daemon AND clients. Never main writes, main node_modules writes, npm install/ci in main, port7461 fixtures, global links/settings writes, production restart/bounce, flowspace3 daemon, or omp update. Never inspect pij inbox logs.

Use flowspace3 search before meaning-shaped discovery (client only), exact grep for identifiers, LSP for symbols but scope-check: worktree LSP can index main and falsely return zero refs. Record friction with harness observe; never drain or clear buffers.
Report start/end via pij-rs report now; messages via pij_send to PM. OMP may misroute live parent messages into internal scouts: explicitly relay to main context. Do not infer silence means approval.

READY receipt assets/receipt-u4.json includes changed paths, constructor signatures/call order/CLI Route match arms, named tests and pre-fix RED strategy, toolchain versions, and ASSUMPTIONS about sibling state/order/ownership. No stubs, fake fallbacks, unimplemented subverbs, or undocumented scope cuts.

Use u3 bulk methods on SqliteOrchestration: list_dispatches(None)->Vec<Dispatch>, list_tasks(None)->Vec<TaskAssignment>, list_projects(), list_streams(None), list_roles(). Consume shared core row DTOs; no per-seat N+1 or duplicate governance store. Decisions own migration0015 and store/decisions.rs.

Anomalies are derived, not persisted. One named core 30min status-stale constant, strict > threshold, legacy parked-seat suppression and exact legacy detail; separate existing 10min stderr nudge unchanged. Real seq evidence and exact relay wrapper required. Five requested kinds all implemented.

report verify must bind to specific latest done seq and resolved parent; subsequent done reopens anomaly. Do not mutate done into verified state without receipt. Question persists an open decision; report clear does not silently resolve it; overdue decisions surface for responsible parent.

Answer auth is resolved asker/self or recorded parent. Prime ruling: self-answer closes via decision.answered with answerer and answer_msg_id=null, NO redundant push. Different authorized answerer pushes from answerer to asker via existing DeliveryService; /send from==to refusal unchanged. Preserve stable message linkage/idempotence; refusal does not silently close a decision.

Core/HTTP/service tests must cover unrelated-answer refusal, self-answer no-push, actual other-answer inbox message, duplicate/conflicting answer, persisted reopen/parent view, verify-after-new-done. PM cross-unit proof lives daemon/tests/governance_composition.rs; do not edit it.
The PM is your interface: acks, questions, done reports. You never message prime or Jordan directly unless the PM's seat is dead.
DEFER to the PM: interface changes (they affect sibling units), dependency additions, schema/migration changes, anything outside your paths.
Your evidence outranks the packet: if the brief is wrong, say so at ack or stop-and-ask with the measurement — do not silently code around it.
